source.summary: GitHub Actions 'Embedder footprint' runs for PR #284 (branch fix/147-async-facade at head d49017889bc96fc71fb2d2c164f5a8d4ac8f1719 — branch commit e9c8e52 (state the component host-function first-poll contract on the async registration surface (#147)) plus merge commit d490178 bringing in current main 8c748aa, so the pull-request run built the same tree; ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45218637130 and 45218665766 against the branch and pull-request run 45217434943, which built the same tree, produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #284 (#147, the component async registration surface states its first-poll contract: canonical contract text on ComponentFuture, first-poll warnings on all six *_async registration methods and the bindgen traits/functions, a corrected false doc claim on register_func_async, and a self-explanatory Pending error message; the decision and roadmap are recorded in docs/component-model/new-component-runtime.md). The branch merged current main (8c748aa, containing PR #286) before measurement, with no conflicts. Attribution was isolated by measuring current main (8c748aa) alone (workflow_dispatch run 45219214659, gate success): it reproduces the previous baseline exactly on all 32 gated series, so every delta is this PR's own. Only 6 of the 32 gated series change, all in stripped file bytes with stripped .text unchanged everywhere: release component and wasi grow by +208 B and wasi-threads by +224 B; release-size component grows by +208 B and wasi and wasi-threads by +224 B. The growth is confined to the configurations that link the component runtime and carries no .text change, consistent with the new contract/warning string literals this PR adds to telomere-component. The remaining 26 series, including the baseline configuration in both profiles, are byte-identical. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth remains the release-size component stripped .text series at +5.47% (1,169,031 B to 1,232,983 B), unchanged from +5.47%. Run-to-run spread was again 0 B for every gated series across the three samples.
